title: Direct Recruitment to various posts in Government of India
body_text:
UPSC invites applications from eligible candidates for direct recruitment to various posts in Government of India.
2. The detailed Special Advertisement No. 52/2026 , along-with instructions to the candidates has been uploaded on the Commission’s website https://upsc.gov.in . Interested candidates can apply through the Online Recruitment Application portal https://upsconline.nic.in/ora/ from 22nd August, 2026 to 11th September, 2026.
3. Candidates are requested to follow the detailed instructions mentioned therein.
